title: WriterLease
description: Exactly one ACTIVE lease may exist per protected resource scope. Enforced by a database partial-unique constraint and compare-and-swap claim, never by UI state or an in-memory boolean.

writer_identity.description: Identity of the sole writer. A watcher identity can never appear here.

fencing_sequence.description: Incremented monotonically on every successful claim for the scope. Never reused, never decremented.

stale_threshold_seconds.description: Missed heartbeats beyond this make the lease claimable by another writer; the stale holder's writes then fail on the fencing check.

force_released_by.description: Force release requires a separately authorized human action and always emits a FORCE_RELEASE audit event.
